First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Slower and shorter than the Tuesday ride, about 13-15 miles.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Thursday Night Gravel, Gravel Curious Ride group ride

Thursday Night Gravel, Gravel Curious Ride is a gravel group ride in Grinnell, IA. It rolls every Thursday at 5:30 pm from Bikes to You.

Imagine Grinnell’s slower Thursday-night gravel ride for the gravel curious, 13 to 15 miles from Bikes to You at 5:30 pm. It runs April 2 to October 29, 2026. Riders can borrow a bike free through the Grinnell Bike Share.
